name: Memory
description: Puts your pinned facts and the earlier chat in front of every message, so a fresh AI chat has the context. Everything goes in full until the max is reached. After that, older messages are summarised in fixed parts (10 messages, then 10 parts, ...) kept as Markdown files next to the chat, one file per level of detail; the oldest go in at the coarsest level and recent messages stay word for word. Works across Sub-chats.

pinned.label: Pinned facts (always sent)
pinned.help: One fact per line. Sent first, never cut or summarised.

every.label: Send memory every N messages
every.help: 1 = every message. Use a higher number if the AI site keeps the chat itself. A new site chat (a new sub-chat) always gets it.

send.label: What to send

options.unseen: Only what this site chat hasn't seen

send.help: The second leaves out messages that already went to this site chat (it has them), which saves room with Sub-chats.

names.label: Name the AI on each line when the chat used more than one site

recent.label: Recent turns sent in full
recent.help: Only used once the memory goes over the max: these stay word for word, older ones get summarised.

budget.label: Max characters of memory
budget.help: Nothing is summarised below this. Pinned facts count too.

ahead.label: Start summarising this many messages before the max
ahead.help: Uses the chat's average message size. Parts are summarised in the background after a reply, so they're ready when the max is reached and sends don't wait for them. 0 = only at the max.

options.summary: Summarise older messages in parts (another chat on the site)
options.clip: Clip older messages, drop the oldest (no extra chat)

chunk.label: Messages per summary part
chunk.help: Level 1 summarises this many messages, level 2 this many level-1 parts, and so on. Parts are fixed: each is made once.

summaryPrompt.label: Summary request (sent with each part)
summaryPrompt.default: Summarise this part of a conversation so it can continue in a new chat that only sees summaries. Keep every name, fact, decision and promise, what each character wants and knows, open threads, the situation at the end of this part and the user's preferences. Leave out small talk. Write plain text, as short as possible without losing any of that. Reply with the summary only.
summaryPrompt.help: Goes after the summary's system prompts, before the turns.

sides.label: Summaries

options.apart: Your side and the AI's side apart (each can be its own piece)

sides.help: Apart: each summary has a User part and an AI part, in one request. In the Pipeline, Add plugin piece puts Pinned facts, Your side, AI side and Recent messages in rows of their own.

summaryHooks.label: Run the profile's plugins on the summary request (e.g. Base64)

clip.label: Characters kept of each older turn (Clip mode, or if a summary fails)
